undertaking.Title: Mission
undertaking.Text: We are committed to the future of children in La Esmeralda through educational actions in language, mathematics, arts, physical education and other areas, promoting inclusion, protection and cognitive development.

sight.Title: Vision
sight.Text: We seek national and international recognition as an institution that applies personalized learning strategies, fostering positive changes in study habits and comprehensive child development.

Contact.Title: Contact Us
Contact.Text: Feel free to contact us if you would like to learn more about our work supporting children and young people through education. We are happy to answer your questions and explain how you can help.

Faq.Title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.Text: Thank you for considering a donation to the CMA Foundation. Here are answers to common questions.

FirstQuestion.question: How will my donation be used?
FirstQuestion.answer: Every donation directly supports educational programs, school supplies and learning resources.

SecondQuestion.question: Is my donation secure?
SecondQuestion.answer: Yes. We use trusted payment providers to process donations securely.

ThirdQuestion.question: Can I make a monthly donation?
ThirdQuestion.answer: Absolutely. Monthly donations help us plan long-term educational projects.

FourthQuestion.question: Can I cancel my monthly donation?
FourthQuestion.answer: Yes. You can modify or cancel recurring donations at any time.

FivethQuestion.question: Will I receive a donation receipt?
FivethQuestion.answer: Yes. You will receive a confirmation email and receipt.

SixthQuestion.question: Why support the CMA Foundation?
SixthQuestion.answer: Your generosity gives children access to education and better opportunities.
